verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no in-product AI that generates insights or suggestions from user data. GlitchTip's built-in MCP server ([glitchtip-docs-9], [glitchtip-docs-19]) only exposes data to the user's own external AI tools, which makes it an integration building block rather than AI insight delivered inside the product. Tools like detect_n_plus_one are likewise surfaced through that MCP interface, not as in-product AI suggestions.
